title: 2.1 Basic Concepts of Climate Change
description: Climate versus weather, global warming, the IPCC definition and the interconnection of Earth systems. Hard level.

questions.question: Why is a single hot summer insufficient as evidence of climate change?
options: Rising air temperature warms oceans, which then fuel stronger storms
It includes changes in variability and both natural and human causes
Climate change requires a persistent pattern over many years
Short fluctuations do not represent a change in climate state
questions.correctAnswer: Climate change requires a persistent pattern over many years

questions.question: What makes the IPCC definition broader than a simple getting-hotter view?
options: Rising air temperature warms oceans, which then fuel stronger storms
They are interdependent, so a change in one place leads to changes elsewhere
Climate change requires a persistent pattern over many years
It includes changes in variability and both natural and human causes
questions.correctAnswer: It includes changes in variability and both natural and human causes

questions.question: What is the chain linking air temperature, ocean heat and storms?
options: It includes changes in variability and both natural and human causes
They are interdependent, so a change in one place leads to changes elsewhere
Rising air temperature warms oceans, which then fuel stronger storms
Climate change requires a persistent pattern over many years
questions.correctAnswer: Rising air temperature warms oceans, which then fuel stronger storms

questions.question: Which concept best captures the interconnectedness of Earth systems?
options: Interdependence of air, water and land
Atmospheric conditions on a particular day
An ecological consequence of global warming
Intergovernmental Panel on Climate Change
questions.correctAnswer: Interdependence of air, water and land

questions.question: Why is the decadal scale used in the IPCC definition?
options: Short fluctuations do not represent a change in climate state
It includes changes in variability and both natural and human causes
Rising air temperature warms oceans, which then fuel stronger storms
Climate change requires a persistent pattern over many years
questions.correctAnswer: Short fluctuations do not represent a change in climate state

questions.question: What role do greenhouse gases play in the climate system?
options: Short fluctuations do not represent a change in climate state
Climate change requires a persistent pattern over many years
Local variations can mislead; the global mean reveals the trend
They trap heat and raise air temperatures near the ground
questions.correctAnswer: They trap heat and raise air temperatures near the ground

questions.question: Which statement distinguishes a climate trend from weather variability?
options: A trend persists across many years while variability is short-term
Climate change requires a persistent pattern over many years
Rising air temperature warms oceans, which then fuel stronger storms
It includes changes in variability and both natural and human causes
questions.correctAnswer: A trend persists across many years while variability is short-term

questions.question: What does loss of wildlife habitats illustrate?
options: Climate is measured over years; weather over a day
An ecological consequence of global warming
Atmospheric conditions on a particular day
A long-term increase in Earth average temperature
questions.correctAnswer: An ecological consequence of global warming

questions.question: Why do scientists study average global temperature rather than one region?
options: Local variations can mislead; the global mean reveals the trend
Rising air temperature warms oceans, which then fuel stronger storms
A trend persists across many years while variability is short-term
It includes changes in variability and both natural and human causes
questions.correctAnswer: Local variations can mislead; the global mean reveals the trend

questions.question: How would you classify Gambella is warm and humid all year long?
options: Typically decades or longer
Gondar is cold in winter
A description of climate
Earth average temperature
